name: libero_agent_30_v0_1
observation_profile_note: Level 1 is head/wrist RGB plus basic robot state; Level 2 adds dynamic proprioception; Level 3 adds metric depth and camera intrinsics/extrinsics. No level publishes bbox, masks, object poses, checker state, or private instance names.
current_semantics_note: Wipe operates on a visible tabletop spill, not the floor.
The matched LiLo text/image variants share five unordered terminal goals so the image task has no hidden action-order requirement.
The coffee-machine and strict-order cooking prototypes are outside this 30-task release.

tasks.name: select_upright_marker
tasks.instruction: Pick up the only upright marker and place it in the collection bin.

tasks.name: select_between_condiments
tasks.instruction: Pick up the object positioned between the other two objects and place it in the basket.

tasks.name: select_red_object
tasks.instruction: Pick up the red object and place it in the collection bin.

tasks.name: select_striped_object
tasks.instruction: Pick up the object with the striped texture and place it in the collection bin.

tasks.name: select_marked_instance
tasks.instruction: Pick up the object with exactly one square mark and place it in the collection bin.

tasks.name: select_ball_shape
tasks.instruction: The three candidate-button pairs show a small ball, a cylinder, and a cube. Press the button paired with the small ball.

tasks.name: select_cola_drink
tasks.instruction: Pick up the cola and place it in the collection bin.

tasks.name: weigh_and_place_heaviest_mug
tasks.instruction: Determine which of the three visually identical mugs is heaviest by physically weighing them, then place the heaviest mug in the green bin.

tasks.name: select_highest_reflectance
tasks.instruction: The three candidate-button pairs have visibly different surface reflectance. Press the button paired with the most reflective object.

tasks.name: select_largest_cylinder
tasks.instruction: The three candidate-button pairs show cylinders of different sizes. Press the button paired with the largest cylinder.

tasks.name: pick_alphabet_soup
tasks.instruction: Pick up the alphabet soup and place it in the basket.

tasks.name: push_plate
tasks.instruction: Push the plate into the green target area in front of the stove.

tasks.name: press_button
tasks.instruction: Press the red button.

tasks.name: close_top_drawer
tasks.instruction: Close the top drawer of the cabinet.

tasks.name: open_top_drawer
tasks.instruction: Open the top drawer of the cabinet.

tasks.name: open_microwave
tasks.instruction: Open the microwave.

tasks.name: turn_on_stove
tasks.instruction: Turn on the stove.

tasks.name: insert_marked_chemistry_tube
tasks.instruction: Pick up the blue chemistry tube and insert it vertically into the rear-center empty slot of the tube rack.

tasks.name: wipe_spill_from_table
tasks.instruction: Pick up the sponge, wipe the entire brown spill, then release the sponge on the blue rest area.

tasks.name: pour_wine_into_mug
tasks.instruction: Pour wine from the bottle into the mug.

tasks.name: prepare_cooking_text_goal
tasks.instruction: Prepare the cooking area. For a prepared cooking area, the frying pan should be on the stove. The stoves should be turned on. The moka pot should be on the nearest stove. The microwave should be open.

tasks.name: prepare_cooking_goal_image
tasks.instruction: Prepare the cooking area to match the provided goal image.

tasks.name: robomemarena_task_04
tasks.instruction: Open and close all drawers in order to check. Put butter into the drawer that already contains an object.

tasks.name: robomemarena_task_07
tasks.instruction: Pour tomato sauce over the frypan twice and place the sauce bottle into the bowl drainer.

tasks.name: rotate_three_bowls_using_empty_plate
tasks.instruction: Cyclically rearrange the three black bowls from left to right in the head camera. No bowl may touch the tabletop at any time.

tasks.name: robomemarena_task_19
tasks.instruction: Pick and place tomato sauce, milk, and orange juice from cabinet1 to cabinet2.

tasks.name: robomemarena_task_12
tasks.instruction: Put cookies into the middle drawer, then put chocolate into the same drawer, and close it.

tasks.name: unlatch_and_open_door
tasks.instruction: Open the door. It is secured by a rotating latch.

tasks.name: drive_nail_with_hammer
tasks.instruction: Drive the nail into the wooden block.

tasks.name: basic_seesaw_usage
tasks.instruction: Lift the hidden object and place it in the basket.
